🔴 Unverified — The content below identifies potential research gaps by reasoning about what is absent from the database. Topics may exist under different names or may not have been indexed. Verify before using this to inform research decisions.
Based on the indexed database of 188 papers on AI & Responsibility topics from UNINOVIS partner universities, the following subtopics commonly discussed in responsible AI literature **do not appear** in the indexed database: - Algorithmic auditing - AI safety (beyond general ethics discussions) - Data sovereignty - Human-AI interaction (beyond specific applications) - AI and disability - AI and environmental impact - AI red-teaming - Adversarial robustness - AI supply chain ethics - AI bias in hiring and recruitment - AI in criminal justice (e.g., predictive policing) - AI in education (beyond general perceptions) - AI in public sector decision-making - AI in defense and military applications - AI in content moderation and governance - AI in financial risk assessment - AI in autonomous vehicles (beyond general discussions) - AI in robotics (beyond specific applications) - AI in climate modeling and environmental monitoring - AI in human rights monitoring - AI in indigenous data governance
